description:
Climber 2.0 24'' Teenager Mountain Bike

Low Step-thru Frame - Easy for teenagers to straddle a bike.
Dual V-brake & Wide Tires - Ensure the riding safety.

Front Suspension - Absorbs bumps for a smoother ride.
Professional 7-Speed Drivetrain - With grip shifters to help young riders learn the gears easily.

Youth-Friendly Design

Hiland hi-ten steel frame is lightweight and durable, and its step-thru style makes young riders easy to stand up and get on and off.

Plus, the comfortable seat and 24-inch wheels make this the most comfortable bike for teenagers to ride around the neighborhood.

Reliable Brake

Equipped with V-brakes that are lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Front and rear steel linear pull handbrakes with kid-sized levers are easy to pull and provide consistent and reliable stopping action on demand, allowing riders to stop quickly in case of an emergency.

Comfortable Riding

The front suspension fork absorbs bumps and provides superb shock resistance over rocks and bumpy terrain for a utmost smooth and comfortable ride.

Sturdy 1.95" wide tires protect kids against flats to keep them riding all day.

Professional Drivetrain

SHIMANO 7-speed drivetrain can better meet the riding needs of various terrains. Simple shifting (1x drivetrain) is the best way to youth's confidence in riding and teach them to ride a real mountain bike.

The grip-type shifter makes it easy for young riders to use the gears and helps them take full control of their bikes.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes. Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

7-Speed Shimano Drivetrain

SHIMANO 7-speed drivetrain with grip-type shifter make kids easy into use gears.

Low Step-thru Frame

Hiland classic style high-carbon steel frame is lower so it's easier for kids to stand over and hop on and off.

Front Suspension

Give you the utmost comfortable riding experience on various kinds of roads.

Wide Tires

Sturdy 1.95 wide tires protect kids against flats to keep them riding all day.

Double V-brake

V-brake is lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Elevate your child's trail riding with the Hiland Climber 24" Mountain Bike. Featuring a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, powerful mechanical disc brakes, and a lockout suspension fork. Designed for kids ages 8-12.
